2124719448548618538.en_summary: China's iron ore imports up 3.1% while steel output down 2.8%, writes @clydecommods. Much of the ore going into inventories not production. Same pattern may emerge in oil: strong imports masking weak consumption. Analysts should distinguish flows from demand. Reuters link.
2124719448548618538.zh_summary: 中國鐵礦石進口上升3.1%，而鋼鐵產量下降2.8%，@clydecommods寫道。大部分礦石進入庫存而非生產。油價可能出現相同模式：強進口掩蓋弱消費。分析師應區分流量與需求。路透連結。

2124717762383663521.en_summary: The S&P 500 fell 8.6% last week, its 12th biggest weekly decline since 1950. Historically following biggest weekly declines, stocks tended to bounce back with above-average forward returns (1-Year: +26% vs. +11% in other periods). No certainties, only probabilities.
